Purpose and scope
Run the pinned official validator and independent MRI checks on the new corpus, documenting reviewed differences rather than changing fixture expectations to match implementation output. Record resolver/profile/source digests, fixture licenses and commands. Update the supported-profile matrix and upstream integration record.

Acceptance proof
Retained reports cover successful families and deliberate invalid fixtures; differences have explicit explanations. Upstream portable JVM/JS tests and downstream family lifecycle cases pass. Documentation accurately distinguishes association coherence from phase physics and scanner qualification.

Start here
scripts/check-mri-conformance.py; scripts/check-mri-headers.py; modules/app/src/test/resources/mri-conformance/README.md; docs/{scientific-core,bids4s-integration}.md

Working agreement
Preserve the existing working-tree baseline. Use current repository contracts, keep historical identities stable, and attach actual verification commands/results before closing. Coordinate shared catalog files, profile versions and migration numbers with other work in this tranche. Planning references: docs/scientific-core.md and docs/implementation-plan.md.
set.title: F5: Qualify the phase-family profile against independent evidence
